title: omp-services configuration, schemaVersion 1
description: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/omp-services/config.json. Holds no secrets: the heartbeat URL lives in its own 0600 file.

labelPrefix.description: Prefix of every launchd label and systemd unit this tool manages. Only units that carry it are ever touched.

path.description: Absolute path of the omp binary the services run. null: found at init (OMP_BIN, PATH, ~/.local/bin/omp) and pinned.
Absolute path of the Python (3.10 or newer) the services run. null: the interpreter that runs init.

enabled.description: Install the heartbeat service. Off until `omp-services heartbeat set-url` has stored a URL.

allowNoChecks.description: A round with no health checks at all sends <URL>/fail instead of <URL>, so a silent misconfiguration is loud. Set true when the heartbeat is only meant to say the machine is alive.

urlFile.description: Absolute path of the 0600 file holding the https ping URL. null: <config dir>/secrets/heartbeat-url.

checkTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline of a check that does not set its own.

cycleTimeoutSeconds.description: All checks of one round together; checks not reached by then count as failed.

allowRemoteUrls.description: Let url and port checks from health.d drop-ins reach hosts other than loopback.

tailscale.description: Absolute path of the tailscale CLI for serve-route checks. null: found on PATH, then the macOS app bundle.

marketplace.description: Name of the omp marketplace the plugins were installed from; used for the newer-version notice and upgrade.

maxBytes.description: A service log larger than this is copied to <name>.1 and truncated by the heartbeat.
